title: ホルムズ海峡でタンカーに攻撃　トランプ氏が通過支援を表明した中で英機関が報告受ける
extracted_text: 【ワシントン＝杉本康士】英海軍の関連機関「英国海運貿易オペレーション」（UKMTO）は4日、イランが事実上封鎖しているエネルギー輸送の要衝ホルムズ海峡で、タンカーが飛翔（ひしょう）体による攻撃を受けたと報告があったと発表した。 同海峡をめぐっては、トランプ米大統領がペルシャ湾内に停泊を余儀なくされている商船に海峡を通過させる措置をとると発表していた。 UKMTOは3日にもホルムズ海峡で、ばら積み船が複数の小型船から攻撃を受けたと発表していた。いずれも乗組員全員の無事が確認されているという。
translated_text: [Washington = Sugimoto Yasushi] The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), a British Navy-related organization, announced on the 4th that it had received a report of a tanker being attacked by a flying object in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz, which Iran has effectively sealed off for energy shipments. Regarding the strait, U.S. President Trump had announced he would take measures to allow merchant ships forced to anchor in the Persian Gulf to pass through the channel. UKWTO had also announced on the 3rd that a bulk carrier was attacked by several small boats in the Strait of Hormuz. In both cases, all crew members were confirmed to be safe.
title_en: Tanker Attacked in Strait of Hormuz; British Agency Reports Incident After Trump Offers Passage Support
